content:wysiwyg_basic:1791743973807:0.95.html:
Sponsor a Red Kettle in Greenville

Businesses and civic organizations are invited to sponsor a Red Kettle in Greenville this Christmas and help support our mission all year long. Contact Justin Heisey for more information.

Matching Opportunities

November 13-14

  • Matching Cap of $10,000 across both days
  • Up to 40+ locations across both dates
  • Live television coverage on November 13

Monday-Thursday (Beginning after Black Friday)

  • Matching Cap of $5,000
  • Up to 30 locations

Friday and Saturday (Beginning on Black Friday)

  • Matching Cap of $7,000
  • Up to 40 locations

Organizations Receive

  • Logo inclusion on all participating kettles on the matching date (min 20, max 40)
  • Social media posts in the lead-up and on the matching date
  • Personalized corporate poster promoting your matching donation
  • Logo inclusion on a thank-you ad in the Community Journal
